reason: The cited evidence does not address the effect of Co removal on SFE or deformation mechanisms in the Co-free alloy. E1 discusses dynamic behavior of the equiatomic alloy but provides no SFE data or Co-removal comparisons. E2 discusses SFE in CoCrNi and interstitial effects, not the FeNiCrMn system. Thus, the key premises lack specific prior support.
premises: Co removal increases the effective stacking fault energy (SFE) of the FeNiCrMn alloy relative to equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi
Higher SFE suppresses deformation twinning and promotes dislocation glide
